location_exception_reason: Bunkhouses are industrial/construction project accommodation structures sold on technical specifications (size, insulation, amenities, portability) and manufacturing capability, not geographic origin. Location of manufacture or delivery is a logistics detail, not a buyer decision factor. No GI-tagged or regional-origin protection applies.
biz_exception_reason: Business-type words ('Manufacturer,' 'Supplier,' 'Dealer') in bunkhouse titles are redundant — IndiaMART's seller-type filter already exposes this independently. Removing 'Manufacturer' from 'MS Bunkhouse Manufacturer' leaves a complete, accurate product title. The business relationship does not change what is being sold.
